content: Label Definitions: Question terms can be mapped to categories using manual heuristics BIBREF19 . To mitigate sparsity and limit heuristic use, here we generated a feature comparing the cosine similarity of composite embedding vectors BIBREF51 representing question text and category definition text, using pretrained GloVe embeddings BIBREF52 . Pilot experiments showed that performance did not significantly improve.
